content: Standard modern pattern for deploying Vite apps to GitHub Pages: use official actions/configure-pages + actions/upload-pages-artifact + actions/deploy-pages in a workflow triggered on push to main, deploying via the native GitHub Pages 'Actions' source (Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions) rather than pushing to a gh-pages branch. Requires Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions set to allow Pages deployment (or explicit permissions: pages: write, id-token: write in the workflow).
